location: East side of the maintenance building roof, near the open edge.
hazard_source: An unprotected roof edge and hand tools left close to the edge, creating fall and dropped-object hazards.
work_activity: Applying sealant during roof membrane repairs.
exposed_objects: The two workers applying sealant on the roof
control_measures: A ground-level exclusion zone was set up.
A temporary guardrail was required before work resumed.
Tool lanyards were required before work resumed.
observation_text: During roof membrane repairs on the east side of the maintenance building, two workers were applying sealant near an open roof edge without a guardrail. Hand tools were left close to the edge, and a ground crew was working directly below. The supervisor stopped the work, set up a ground-level exclusion zone, and required a temporary guardrail and tool lanyards before work resumed.
